title: fix(spec,service-automation,metadata-protocol): the v18 stored preview lists every row protocol 18 refuses and no conversion rewrites
body:
Fixes #23269
Fixes #23270
Fixes #23271
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What this does

`os migrate meta --stored` now lists every stored row that protocol 18 refuses and that no conversion rewrites. Before, the preview counted each such row as `canonical` ("already on protocol"), while the parse or the boot refused it after the upgrade. All three cards get the same fate, **refused and listed**, through the stored preview's existing TODO lines. Each line names the step-18 D3 entry that refuses the shape, the site, and the choice the owner has to make. Nothing is rewritten, on preview or on `--apply`, and `storedMigrationClean` does not move.

| card | shape | fate | listed by | TODO id |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #23269 | a flow value slot carrying a `{…}` token, including a `get_record` / `update_record` / `delete_record` filter operand | refuse and list | flow, node, path | `flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused` |
| #23270 | `controlled_by_parent` with two masters (both required, or neither), no master, a required `lookup` only, an explicit `required: false` | refuse and list, each with its own fate sentence | object | `cbp-master-relation-tiers-retired` |
| #23271 | a view whose `data` binds the retired view-level API source, in every stored view body spelling and in an object's `listViews` | refuse and list; request headers withheld | view | `view-data-api-provider-retired` |

The one lossless shape in this family, a single `master_detail` with `required` omitted, is still converted by `cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted` and is not listed.

## Public surface: Clause ②, yes (widening)

No door accepts or refuses anything it did not before. The published flow-canonicalization result gains one output member, declared in the contract and read through it:
- `IAutomationService.canonicalizeStoredFlow(...).todos?` (`@objectstack/spec`, `contracts/automation-service.ts`): optional, the sibling of `notices` and `conflicts`, so an implementation that reports none still conforms.
- `AutomationEngine.canonicalizeStoredFlow(...).todos` (`@objectstack/service-automation`): the engine always returns it.
- `StoredFlowCanonicalization.todos?` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`): restates the contract's optional member, so `flowResult.todos ?? []` reads a member the contract declares.

Also widened: the published `ConversionTodoNotice.conversionId` may now name a D3 entry as well as a conversion, and an `onTodo` sink now also receives the refused-shape TODOs. All three packages ship `minor` (`.changeset/23269-v18-stored-row-fates.md`).

## The #23269 choice, measured: (b) refuse and list

The lane's ruling allowed (a) only if the chain already declares an operator-applied rewrite of stored rows that is separate from the load-path D2. It does not:
- `migrateStoredMetadata` (the `--stored` pass) writes back the read path's own pass: `applyConversionsToStoredItem` for most types, and `AutomationEngine.canonicalizeStoredFlow` for a flow, which is the `registerFlow` seam itself.
- `--from 17` (`applyMetaMigrations`) replays step conversions over authored source files, never over rows.
- The decision-mode precedent (`flow-decision-mode-inclusive-explicit`) shows the same boundary. It replays over authored sources only and is refused at rehydration by `CONVERSIONS_NOT_REPLAYED_AT_REHYDRATION`. For stored rows it ships a report-only list, not a rewrite.

So (b) applies, and the changeset names it.

## Zone 2 assumptions, each measured

1. **The report channel: partly disproved.**
   - The D3 entries carry no stored-row detector, and `--stored` never reads D3 entries. What it does read is the conversion TODO sink (`onTodo`, `CONVERSION_TODO_CODE`). For a flow row, `migrateStoredMetadata` hardcoded `todos: []` and ran only `canonicalizeStoredFlow`.
   - Why the cloud seat's preview named no refused flow: `FlowSchema.safeParse` accepts a `get_record` filter of `{ id: '{record.id}' }`, which I measured at `success: true` on this tree. The refusal is `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals`, which only `registerFlow`'s `validateFlowExpressions` runs, after canonicalization. Objects and views had the same gap: the preview never parses a row it does not rewrite, so a refused row read as `canonical`.
   - A TODO-only D2 entry would have been wrong: `spec-changes.json` projects every D2 entry as "A lossless conversion applied at load". The detectors therefore live in their own in-package list (`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`). They are keyed by their D3 entry ids, they run at the end of `applyConversions` only when a caller passes `onTodo`, and they never rewrite.
2. **#23270's shapes: holds.** No shape converts losslessly. Two masters need a pick. A required `lookup` turned into a `master_detail` changes delete behaviour. An explicit `required: false` is a contradiction the builder refuses: writing `true` would change what the field accepts and override what the author wrote. No master leaves nothing to convert.
3. **#23271's move: holds.** No mechanical move exists. A page must exist to carry the `dataSource`, and deleting `data` makes the view query its object instead. The population is not provably empty: the save door accepted the arm before #23160, so I list instead of treating the population as empty.
4. **The predicate: holds, and is shared.** The detector reuses ObjectSchema's one-required-master predicate, extracted into the internal module `packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts`. It is not re-exported, so #23272 stays its own card. The refinement's messages are byte-identical. The view detector asks `ViewDataSchema.safeParse` itself, and the flow detector calls `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals`, so each listing is exactly what its door refuses.
5. **The boot behaviour: holds.** It is out of scope, reported below, and the runtime is not changed.
6. **Hot files.** No generated file is committed. `registry.ts` is gitignored and regenerated at install, build and test. I merged `main` three times, never with a conflict.

## Where it lands, and why outside the claim's file surface

The claim's surface is `packages/spec`. For flows, measurement put the producer elsewhere, and the dispatch's file-surface clause says to fix at the producer and name it. Changing `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta*` (the dispatch's STOP path) was not needed: the CLI renders `formatStoredMigrationReport`, which lives in metadata-protocol.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`: `canonicalizeStoredFlow` passes `onTodo` and returns `todos` beside `notices` and `conflicts`. `registerFlow` ignores them, because its own refusal names the same sites.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts`: `StoredFlowCanonicalization` gains an optional `todos`, so a caller-supplied canonicalizer that reports none still fits.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: the flow branch reads `flowResult.todos ?? []`. The skip reason of a row that only has TODOs no longer says "The row keeps loading unchanged", which this change would have made false for a refused flow. It now says the row is read as stored and that each TODO says what that leaves it doing.

Inside `packages/spec`:
- `conversions/refused-shapes.ts` (new), `conversions/apply.ts` (the call), and doc-only edits to `conversions/types.ts` (a TODO's `conversionId` may name a D3 entry) and `conversions/stored.ts`;
- `contracts/automation-service.ts`: `canonicalizeStoredFlow`'s return declares `todos?` (the public-surface section above);
- `data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts` (new) and `data/object.zod.ts` (the refinement delegates to it);
- one sentence on each of the three D3 entries, saying what `--stored` does with these rows.

Docs: one row in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`'s `--stored` decline table. Changeset: `.changeset/23269-v18-stored-row-fates.md` (`minor` for spec, service-automation and metadata-protocol).

Both new spec modules (`refused-shapes.ts`, `controlled-by-parent-master.ts`) are internal: neither is re-exported, so no export name changes. The one contract member they need is declared above.

## Reach decision: all value slots, not only CRUD filters

The flow detector lists every refusal of `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals`, not only the CRUD filter operands. That is the D3 entry `flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused` whole, and `registerFlow` refuses every one of those sites the same way. Limiting it to filters would have taken extra code that filters the one judge, and the preview would have stayed silent about flows the boot refuses for the same retirement. The four conditions for a bounded in-place fix hold: same defect class, mechanical, no other claim on these files, same gate family.

## Pins

- **#23269:**
  - a braced operand on `get_record`, `update_record` and `delete_record` (field value, `$gt` comparand, `$in` element), and one inside a loop body: one TODO each, naming the flow, the node and the operand, with its CEL envelope;
  - CEL-envelope, query-placeholder and literal flows: untouched and not listed;
  - the engine returns the TODO, and `registerFlow` refuses the same site;
  - the preview lists the flow, `--apply` writes nothing, and the CEL form is `canonical` and registers.
  - "A converted row boots and runs" does not apply under (b): no row converts. The CEL-form row booting is pinned instead.
- **#23270:**
  - one pin per shape: two required masters, two unrequired masters, explicit `required: false`, required lookup only, no master;
  - three conforming objects untouched;
  - the Studio shape still converts and is not listed;
  - another sharing model is not listed;
  - the preview lists four objects, counts the conforming one `canonical`, writes nothing on `--apply`, and leaves `storedMigrationClean` true.
- **#23271:**
  - all five stored view spellings, and an object's `listViews`: listed;
  - no header value reaches `from`, `reason` or `message`;
  - `object`, `value` and `schema` providers: untouched.

## Verification

### Patch round, at `HEAD` `086d6f1ad` (merge base with `origin/main`: `404fc477e`)

The contract-tier review (record 6152721854) failed this PR on the semver and Clause-② section only. This round makes its three edits, with no change to any door, detector or predicate:
- the contract declares `todos?`;
- the changeset is `minor` for all three packages, with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` naming the three members;
- this body's `Clause-②` line matches.

`main` was merged first: `331fa99bb`, no conflict.

- Build: `turbo run build` over the closures of `@objectstack/service-automation^...` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol^...`, plus the `@objectstack/client...` and `@objectstack/client-react...` closures: 35 of 35 tasks, exit 0.

- Reverse verification of the contract change: `AutomationEngine.canonicalizeStoredFlow`'s `todos` widened to `ConversionTodoNotice[] | number` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. `tsc --noEmit` in service-automation went red as predicted: `src/engine.ts(4364,5): error TS2416: Property 'canonicalizeStoredFlow' in type 'AutomationEngine' is not assignable to the same property in base type 'IAutomationService'`. A contract without `todos` would accept that member, so the red proves `tsc` read the rebuilt `dist` declarations. Restore proven: blob equal to `HEAD`, empty `git diff HEAD`.
- `typecheck` for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-automation` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: exit 0 each.

  - metadata-protocol: `protocol.stored-migration` and `protocol.flow-canonicalizer`, 60 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: measured in full, exit 0, 58 files, 1007 tests.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 115 commands at `086d6f1ad`, with no stale-tree warning. All exited 0, the Clause-② gates (`check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`) and `check:api-surface` included.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3), because 33 packages had no `dist` in the recreated worktree. Re-run after the battery, whose later gates built them, it gave exit 0: "108 published require entry point(s) across 67 package(s) load".

  - `origin/main` has since gained `87e902dcb`, `4d4040ccb` and `37510aa0f`, none under the three changed packages. Not merged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Real producers of the #23269 shape.** hotcrm at `0f84c9c` has 19 flow files (35 lines) whose `filter:` carries a dotted-path braced token. Cloud's AI build wrote it while the skill taught `filter: { id: '{record.id}' }`, per #23269.
- **Out of scope here:** a page component whose `data` (`object-grid`, and the other component whose `data` is `ViewDataSchema`) binds the retired API source is refused by the same schema but is not listed. #23160's D3 entry scopes the retirement to views and object list views, and this listing follows that scope. Carrier: none.
- **Out of scope here:** the other `registerFlow` refusals (text-slot `{{ }}` holes, unknown config keys, decision modes) are still not previewed. The general shape would be the stored pass running `registerFlow`'s whole validation. Carrier: none.
